name: Groove
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Groove, turn one support mailbox into an assigned team inbox with a knowledge base. The hard boundary is email reliability, reporting, rules, integrations, and mature simplicity, plus channel integrations and support operations.
